data.title: USDC, CCTP now available on OKX's X Layer, providing stablecoin features and cross-chain compatibility for DeFi and payments.
data.description: OKX's X Layer has recently launched USDC and CCTP, providing a secure stablecoin solution and enabling cross-chain compatibility for DeFi and payment transactions. This move offers users access to regulated stablecoin functionality on the platform.

data.title: CCOI Stockholders with Large Losses Should Contact Robbins LLP for Information About Recovering Their Losses Against Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc.
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in San Diego, a shareholder rights law firm, Robbins LLP, issued a reminder to investors about a securities class action lawsuit filed for individuals and entities who bought or acquired Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI) common stock. The lawsuit includes all those who purchased the stock on specific dates.

data.title: NIRON MAGNETICS RECEIVES CONDITIONAL $150 MILLION DEPARTMENT OF WAR COMMITMENT
data.description: Niron Magnetics is set to receive financial support of around $150 million for the construction and equipment of their manufacturing plant in Sartell, Minnesota. The plant will specialize in producing Rare-earth-free Iron Nitride magnets, which do not rely on scarce rare earth materials. This innovative technology paves the way for a fresh method in domestic magnet manufacturing. The funding includes a 20-year direct loan commitment, indicating a significant long-term investment in this venture.

data.title: THOUSANDS OF CONTRA COSTA COUNTY TEAMSTERS SET STRIKE DATE
data.description: More than 2,000 employees of Contra Costa County are currently looking to negotiate cost of living adjustments in mediation. Specifically, over 2,000 Teamsters in the county have indicated that they plan to go on strike starting August 19 if a new contract deal is not finalized by then.

data.title: HealthConnect One to Host Community Birth Support Luncheon in Oak Bluffs, Kicking Off Black Breastfeeding Week
data.description: A cost-free gathering is set to unite doulas, birth workers, and families to promote birth equity on Martha's Vineyard. The event, taking place in Oak Bluffs, Massachusetts on August 7, 2026, will feature a special appearance by actress Naturi Naughton. HealthConnect One, a nationwide nonprofit focused on promoting healthy practices, will be organizing the event.

data.title: Uranium Royalty Appoints New Directors to the Board
data.description: On August 7, 2026, Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) based in Lakewood, Colorado, welcomed two new members, Kevin McQuilkin and Peter Rozenauers, to its Board of Directors. This decision is effective immediately. The company's Board made the assessment that Mr. McQuilkin brings valuable expertise and knowledge to the team.

data.title: HealthConnect One Leadership to Join 2026 Black Maternal Health Conference & Training Institute, Reinforcing Commitment to Maternal Health Equity
data.description: In Atlanta on August 7, 2026, Dr. Twylla Dillion, the President & CEO of HealthConnect One, will guide a group of experts in Black maternal health to BMHC26. This team includes Tiwani Oseni, the National Advocacy Manager, and Dr. Breana Turner, the Research Liaison. The BMHC26 event is a prominent national conference focused on Black maternal health.

data.title: AbCellera to Announce Top-Line Results from the Phase 2 Trial of ABCL635 for the Treatment of Moderate-to-Severe VMS Due to Menopause on Monday, August 10, 2026
data.description: AbCellera, a company based in Vancouver, British Columbia, is set to reveal the top-line findings from the Phase 2 clinical study of ABCL635. This trial focuses on assessing the drug's efficacy in managing moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms (VMS) linked to menopause. The anticipated date for this announcement is August 10, 2026. Stay tuned to learn more about the outcomes of this study.
Company Expion360 discloses Q2 2026 financial and operational performance data without revealing profits or revenues.

data.title: LodgeLink to Present at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
data.description: On August 7, 2026, LodgeLink, a subsidiary of Black Diamond Group Limited, is set to take part in Canaccord’s 46th Annual Growth Conference and conduct individual investor meetings. Black Diamond Group Limited is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: BDI) and the OTCQX Exchange (BDIMF). This development signifies a significant opportunity for the Company to engage with investors and showcase their growth strategies.
Birchtech reveals outcomes of vote at yearly stockholders' meeting.

data.title: iSpecimen Inc. Announces Closing of $5 Million Public Offering of Common Stock and Pre-Funded Warrants
data.description: iSpecimen Inc., headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, disclosed the conclusion of its recent public offering. The offering comprised 996,231 shares of the Company’s common stock alongside pre-funded warrants enabling the purchase of 2,849,923 common stock shares. The total purchase amounted to around $5.0 million. The company plans to allocate the offering proceeds towards repaying existing debts, potential asset acquisitions, investments in various ventures, and marketing services, with the remaining funds designated for working capital needs.

data.title: Atico Announces 2026 AGM Voting Results and Stepdown of Michael Winn as Director
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia on August 7, 2026, Atico Mining Corporation (TSX.V: ATY | OTCIQ: ATCMF) revealed the outcomes of its 2026 annual general meeting. The meeting saw the successful passage of all resolutions put forth, marking a positive outcome for the company and its shareholders.

data.title: US Treasury hits 2 crypto exchanges for laundering millions for Iran's Revolutionary Guard, including Georgia-UAE operator and Iran-based platform.
data.description: The U.S. Treasury has imposed sanctions on two cryptocurrency exchanges for allegedly laundering millions of dollars on behalf of Iran's Revolutionary Guard. The targeted exchanges include one based in Georgia and the UAE, as well as an Iran-based platform. These exchanges are accused of facilitating illicit financial transactions amounting to sizable sums for the designated terrorist organization.

data.title: Lemonade to Present at the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference
data.description: On August 7, 2026, Lemonade (NYSE: LMND) revealed that Tim Bixby, the Chief Financial Officer, will be speaking at the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference on August 12, 2026, at 1:15 pm ET. This conference serves as a platform for industry leaders to discuss the latest trends and developments in the technology, internet, and communications sectors.

data.title: ArcherFRS Powers Nation's First EMS-Driven Whole Blood Drone Delivery Program with Hillsborough County Fire Rescue and Tampa General Hospital
data.description: Located in Tampa, Florida, Archer First Response Systems (ArcherFRS) highlighted their contribution in facilitating the country's first fully managed emergency drone logistics on August 7, 2026. By streamlining a typically intricate process, they have transformed it into a straightforward and less burdensome capability for agencies. This advancement emphasizes the crucial role played by ArcherFRS in making complex drone operations more accessible and efficient.

data.title: MedStar Health and the Baltimore Ravens Treat Kids to the Ultimate Fan Experience at Ravens Training Camp
data.description: In Owings Mills, Maryland on August 7, 2026, a significant event took place for young football enthusiasts when five pediatric patients and their families from MedStar Health had the opportunity to attend the Baltimore Ravens Training Camp. The families were brought to the camp by MedStar Health for a day filled with cheering on their beloved players. This heartwarming initiative provided the young fans with an unforgettable experience and a much-needed break from their medical challenges.

data.title: Crowe closes strategic investment from KKR
data.description: In a recent announcement made on August 7, 2026, in Chicago and New York, Crowe LLP (Crowe), a prominent public accounting and consulting firm, disclosed its plans to persist in advancing its business strategy. The firm aims to expand its reach and enhance its capabilities. This development comes following the partnership agreement between Crowe and KKR, a top global investment firm. Funds managed by KKR will be instrumental in supporting Crowe's growth initiatives.

data.title: Havertys Furniture Third Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend and Additional Authorization Under Stock Repurchase Program
data.description: Atlanta, August 7th, 2026 - Haverty Furniture Companies, Inc. (NYSE: HVT and HVT.A) revealed that its Board of Directors has approved a cash dividend for shareholders of its two classes of $1 par value common stock. The dividend payout will be made on the outstanding shares, providing investors with a return on their investment in the Company.

data.title: First Horizon Recognized on Memphis Business Journal's "Best Places to Work in Memphis" List
data.description: A company based in Memphis, Tennessee, First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN), has recently been honored for the fifth time by being included in the Large Companies category of the Best Places to Work in Memphis list by the Memphis Business Journal. The recognition highlights First Horizon's strong commitment to creating a positive work environment.
